```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(scRepertoire)
library(VDJdive)
library(ggpubr)

source("/home/ecb86/Desktop/R_tools/VDJdive_ECLIPSE_paperFunctions.R")
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Pre-Processing                               ###
############################################################################

braun <- readRDS("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/processed/braun_cancer_cell_seurat.rds")

braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% separate(Sample, into = c("donor", "tissue"), remove = FALSE, sep = "_")
braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% mutate(tissue = case_when(
                                                                 tissue %in% c("T", "T2") ~ "Tumor",
                                                                 tissue == "N" ~ "Normal",
                                                                 tissue %in% c("M", "V")  ~ "Other"))

cd8 <- subset(braun, subset = ClusterName_TCells %in% c("Treg", "Activated CD4.1", "Activated CD4.2", "CD4 TCM.1", "CD4 TCM.2", "Mito-high T cells", "-1"), invert = TRUE)

dirs <- list.files("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output_indexHoppingRemoved", recursive = TRUE, pattern = "all_contig_annotations\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
dirs <- dirs[!str_detect(dirs, "SC_VDJ_ASSEMBLER_CS")]
dirs <- str_replace(dirs, "all.*$", "")

matching <- read.csv("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/ecb86/sc_datasets/braun_cancer_cell/braun_matching2.csv")
matching <- matching %>% filter(Sample != "")

cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
cd8@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8@meta.data)
rownames(cd8@meta.data) <- cd8$Cell_barcode
cd8$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(cd8$Cell_barcode, "\\-.*$", "-1")

ElbowPlot(cd8, ndims = 50)
cd8 <- RunUMAP(cd8, dims = 1:30)

cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "PMCH+ terminally Exhausted CD8.1"] <- "PMCH+ terminally \n Exhausted CD8.1"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.2"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.2"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.3"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.3"
```


```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 1A                                ###
############################################################################
cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% mutate(clusters2 = case_when(
                                                                str_detect(ClusterName_TCells, "CD8 TRM") ~ "Resident\nmemory",
                                                                str_detect(ClusterName_TCells, "^Exhausted") ~ "Exhausted",
                                                                str_detect(ClusterName_TCells, "Cytotoxic") ~ "Cytotoxic",
                                                                str_detect(ClusterName_TCells, "erminally") ~ "Terminally\nexhausted",
                                                                str_detect(ClusterName_TCells, "Proliferating") ~ "Proliferating"))
                                                                
FetchData(cd8, c("umap_1", "umap_2", "clusters2")) %>% ggplot(aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
                                                       geom_point(aes(color = clusters2), size = 0.01, shape = 16) +      
                                                       theme_void() + 
                                                       ggtitle("") + 
                                                       theme(legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 4.9, margin = margin(l = 1)), 
                                                             legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-0.2, "cm"),
                                                             legend.key.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
                                                             legend.position = "top",
                                                             legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0),
                                                             legend.box.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0)) +
                                                       guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3), keywidth = 0.01)) +
                                                       scale_color_manual(values = c("aquamarine3", "firebrick2", "orchid4", "steelblue", "chocolate1")) +
                                                       labs(color = "")
                                          


ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/1a.pdf", width = 1.7, height = 2.0, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 1B                                ###
############################################################################

cd8_all <- scRep(cd8, folders = dirs, file = "all", batch = "index", group = "tissue", original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", keepConfidentContigs = TRUE)

cd8_all@meta.data <- cd8_all@meta.data %>% mutate(chain_count = case_when(
                                                                           is.na(CTaa) ~ 0,
                                                                          !is.na(CTaa) ~ 2 + str_count(CTaa, ";") - str_detect(CTaa, "^NA_|_NA$")))

cd8_all@meta.data <- cd8_all@meta.data %>% mutate(chain_count2 = case_when(
                                                                           chain_count > 3 ~ "4+",
                                                                           chain_count <= 3 ~ as.factor(chain_count)))



FetchData(cd8_all, c("umap_1", "umap_2", "chain_count2")) %>% ggplot(aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
                                                              geom_point(aes(color = chain_count2), size = 0.01, shape = 16) +      
                                                              theme_void() + 
                                                              ggtitle("") + 
                                                              theme(legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 4.9, margin = margin(b = 0, l = 1)), 
                                                                    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-0.2, "cm"),
                                                                    legend.key.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
                                                                    legend.position = "top",
                                                                    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0),
                                                                    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -10, b = 0),
                                                                    legend.title.position = "top",
                                                                    legend.title = element_text(size = 6, margin = margin(b = -2), hjust = 0.5)) +
                                                              guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3), keywidth = 0.01)) +
                                                              scale_color_manual(values = c("grey92", "lightskyblue1", "deepskyblue3", "blue", "navyblue"),
                                                                                 limits = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4+")) +
                                                              labs(color = "TCR chain count")


ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/1b1.pdf", width = 1.7, height = 1.9, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

chains <- FetchData(cd8_all, c("umap_1", "umap_2", "chain_count2")) %>% 
            mutate(size = nrow(cd8@meta.data)) %>%
            group_by(chain_count2) %>% 
            summarise(pct = 100 * n() / dplyr::first(size))

chains$chain_count2 <- factor(chains$chain_count2, levels = c("4+", "3", "2", "1", "0"))

chains %>% ggplot() + 
           geom_col(aes(x = 1, y = pct, fill = chain_count2), color = "white", lwd = 0.2) + coord_flip() + 
           theme_classic() +
           geom_vline(xintercept = 0.45, lwd = 0.6) + 
           labs(x = "", y = "", title = "% of cells") + 
           scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
           scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), 
                              labels = c("0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100"), 
                              expand = c(0, 0), 
                              limits = c(-0.2, 100.2),
                              guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) + 
           scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey92", "lightskyblue1", "deepskyblue3", "blue", "navyblue"),
                             limits = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4+")) +
           theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
                 axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                 axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"), 
                 axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),  
                 legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
                 axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
                 axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
                 legend.position = "none", 
                 axis.line = element_blank(), 
                 plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.8, 0.5, 0.5), "cm"), 
                 plot.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/1b2.pdf", width = 2.5, height = 0.96, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 1C                                ###
############################################################################

cd8_all@meta.data <- cd8_all@meta.data %>% mutate(missing = case_when(
                                                                       str_detect(CTaa, "^NA_|_NA$") ~ "Missing\nOne Chain",
                                                                      !str_detect(CTaa, "^NA_|_NA$") ~ "Both Chains\nDetected",
                                                                      is.na(CTaa) ~ "Missing\nBoth Chains"),
                                                  extra = case_when(
                                                                       str_detect(CTaa, ";") ~ "Extra Chains",
                                                                      !str_detect(CTaa, ";") ~ "<=1 for\nBoth Chains",
                                                                      is.na(CTaa) ~ "No TCR\nDetected"),
                                                  regular = case_when(
                                                                       !str_detect(CTaa, "^NA_|_NA$") & !str_detect(CTaa, ";") ~ "Regular Chains", 
                                                                       str_detect(CTaa, "^NA_|_NA$") & str_detect(CTaa, ";") ~ "Missing Chain\n& Extra of\nOther Chain",
                                                                       str_detect(CTaa, "^NA_|_NA$") & !str_detect(CTaa, ";") ~ "Missing Chain",
                                                                       !str_detect(CTaa, "^NA_|_NA$") & str_detect(CTaa, ";") ~ "Extra Chain",
                                                                       is.na(CTaa) ~ "No TCR\nDetected"))

df <- cd8_all@meta.data %>% group_by(donor) %>% 
                            mutate(donorCount = n()) %>%
                            group_by(donor, regular) %>% 
                            summarise(pct = 100 * n() / dplyr::first(donorCount),
                                      donorCount = dplyr::first(donorCount),
                                      count = n())

df <- df %>% group_by(donor) %>% 
             mutate(regularSize = pct[which(regular == "Regular Chains")]) %>% 
             ungroup()

df$regular <- factor(df$regular, levels = c("No TCR\nDetected", "Missing Chain\n& Extra of\nOther Chain", "Missing Chain", "Extra Chain", "Regular Chains"))

df %>% ggplot() + geom_col(aes(x = reorder(donor, regularSize), y = pct, fill = regular), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.90) + 
                  labs(fill = "", x = "Patient", y = "% of cells") +
                  theme_bw() + 
                  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"), 
                        axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"), 
                        legend.position = "bottom", 
                        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                        axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
                        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                        axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3), 
                        legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 4, margin = margin(l = 1, r = -1)), 
                        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"), 
                        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.5),
                        plot.margin = unit(c(0.1, 0.7, 0.1, 0.1), "cm"),
                        panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.7),
                        panel.grid = element_blank(),
                        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
                        legend.box.margin = margin(t = -10, b = 0)) +
                  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0.015), 
                                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), 
                                     labels = c("0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100"),
                                     guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) + 
                  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.045, 0.045)) +
                  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey95", "black", "lightskyblue1", "blue", "deepskyblue3"),
                                    breaks = c("No TCR\nDetected", "Missing Chain\n& Extra of\nOther Chain", "Missing Chain", "Extra Chain", "Regular Chains"),
                                    labels = c("No TCR\ndetected", "Missing chain\n& extra of\nother chain", "Missing\nchain", "Extra\nchain", "1 TCRα &\n1 TCRβ")) +
                  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))


ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/1c.pdf", width = 3, height = 2.4, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)


### Calculating percentages for text
median(df$pct[df$regular == "Regular Chains"])
max(df$pct[df$regular == "Regular Chains"])
min(df$pct[df$regular == "Regular Chains"])

df2 <- df %>% filter(!regular %in% c("No TCR\nDetected", "Regular Chains")) %>%
              group_by(donor) %>% summarise(newPct = sum(pct))

median(df2$newPct)
max(df2$newPct)
min(df2$newPct)

```
